description: E1: Orrik the Fetterer's fight proven on a flat 520 x 520 m floor - the Moot's 60 m ring of stones and its low wall with a south gate, the Stone Throne at its north edge, five fetter-winches staked inside the ring and their Skarn crews (encounter.throne_test_warband: the ThroneChallenge arena brings them in when the fight engages; test.throne.manual is never set).
